_comment: Model prices, in CENTS PER MILLION TOKENS. The single place a dollar figure
for the drafting lane comes from. Never hand-price a run: a remembered price
list is what put $145.11 into the medical-chronology skill for a day, priced
at a rate card two generations stale.
DUPLICATION, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: the medical-chronology pipeline
carries the same card inline as `RATES` in its own ledger.py (venturecrane/
two are separate repos and neither can import the other, so they are kept in
step by hand until one of them is made to read this file. When you change a
price here, change it there in the same breath, and move `as_of` on both.
tests/drafting-ledger.test.ts pins the shape of this file, not its agreement
with the other copy, because CI here cannot see the private repo.
